_provenance: Canadian bill payment intermediaries and rails catalog. Defines transaction fees, reward triggers (e.g. Chexy recurring multiplier), float yields (Neo Financial), and card-specific direct bill pay capabilities (Canadian Tire Triangle).

intermediaries.name: Chexy
intermediaries.description: Processes payments through credit card recurring billing (MCC 4900). Ideal for cards with 4%+ recurring multipliers (e.g. Scotiabank Momentum Visa Infinite).

intermediaries.name: Canadian Tire Triangle Bill Pay
intermediaries.description: Direct electronic bill payment via Canadian Tire Bank portal. 0% fee and earns 1.0% back in CT Money on municipal payees, utilities, and taxes.

intermediaries.name: Neo Financial (Neobanc)
intermediaries.description: Zero-fee bill payments paired with high-yield interest float on funds held prior to due date, plus Neo ecosystem cash back perks.

intermediaries.name: Standard Bank Bill Pay (EFT)
intermediaries.description: Direct chequing account electronic funds transfer via traditional Canadian bank. 0% fees, 0% rewards baseline.
